ai_summary: Aban Offshore Limited, currently undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) since September 2025, has received a "Disclaimer of Opinion" from its auditors for the year ended March 31, 2026. This critical red flag stems from the auditors' inability to verify significant bank balances and borrowings, and a material uncertainty exists regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern given its severe financial distress, eroded net worth, and loan defaults. The financial results also incorporate accounting adjustments related to the CIRP, such as non-provision of interest on bank borrowings and dividends on preference shares, potentially understating liabilities and obscuring a complete financial view.
